facts.business: YES BANK Limited is an Indian private sector bank providing retail, commercial, and corporate banking services with a focus on digital payments, MSME financing, and technology-driven financial solutions.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matters identified: (1) Identification, classification and provisioning of NPAs due to significant credit risk exposure and high degree of complexity, uncertainty and judgment; (2) IT Systems and General Controls due to high dependence on Core Banking and Treasury Solutions

key_risks: Credit risk exposure across various sectors, products, industries and geographies
High complexity, uncertainty and judgment in NPA identification, classification and provisioning
Dependence on IT systems (Core Banking and Treasury Solutions) for financial accounting and reporting
